Name: Set Finder - Fashion Sense Add-On
Author: Wooa404
Description:
Set Finder - Fashion Sense Add-On
Have you ever downloaded a beautiful Fashion Sense outfit, only to get in-game and wonder:
[b]“Wait... which shirt, pants, and accessories were supposed to go together?”[/b]
[b]Set Finder[/b] is a small add-on for Fashion Sense that helps you find [b]other pieces from the same outfit set[/b].
Select a Fashion Sense item and click the [b]puzzle icon 🧩[/b] in the Fashion Sense interface. Set Finder will search for other items that appear to belong to the same set and display them in a small window.
It also adds a [b]NEW indicator[/b] to newly discovered Fashion Sense items, making it easier to spot content you've just added.
[heading]
Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]🧩 Find other pieces from the same outfit set[/*]
[*][ new ] Highlights newly discovered Fashion Sense items with a [b]NEW[/b] indicator during the current game session[/*]
[*]Automatically identifies sets using [b]content pack and item names[/b][/*]
[*]Works directly inside the Fashion Sense interface[/*]
[*]Displays only the related set pieces[/*]
[*]Simple and lightweight — no separate wardrobe or outfit management system[/*]
[/list][heading]
How Set Finder Identifies a Set[/heading]
Fashion Sense content packs do not provide explicit information about which individual items belong to the same outfit set, so Set Finder identifies sets automatically.
Set Finder looks for items [b]within the same Fashion Sense content pack[/b] and compares their names to find a shared set name.
For example:
- Rose Top
- Rose Pants
- Rose Sleeves
- Rose Shoes

These items are from the same content pack and share [b]“Rose”[/b] in their names, so Set Finder identifies them as pieces of the same set.
Items from different Fashion Sense content packs are [b]not combined into the same set[/b], even if their names are similar.
Because sets are identified automatically based on content pack and item naming, [b]Set Finder may not recognize every outfit correctly[/b]. If the individual pieces of an outfit use completely different names, there may not be enough information for Set Finder to determine that they belong together.
[heading]
How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Open the [b]Fashion Sense[/b] interface.[/*]
[*]Select the item you want to find a set for.[/*]
[*]Click the [b]puzzle icon 🧩[/b].[/*]
[*]Set Finder will display the other pieces it identifies as belonging to the same set.[/*]
[/list]If no related pieces can be found, Set Finder will simply let you know.
[heading]
NEW Indicator[/heading]
Set Finder also helps you find Fashion Sense content you've recently added.
Newly discovered items are marked with a [b]NEW[/b] indicator in the Fashion Sense interface during the current game session.
This makes it easier to find the new clothes you just downloaded without having to remember their names or search through your entire collection.
[heading]
Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense[/b][/*]
[/list][heading]
Compatibility & Support[/heading]
Set Finder is an [b]unofficial third-party add-on for Fashion Sense[/b].
[b]If you experience an issue with Set Finder, please report it on the Set Finder mod page rather than to the Fashion Sense developers.[/b]
When reporting a bug, please include your [b]SMAPI log link[/b] if possible.
[heading]
Credits[/heading]
Special thanks to [b]PeacefulEnd[/b], the creator of Fashion Sense, for allowing Set Finder to integrate with the Fashion Sense interface. ❤️
